html:
90 Days Free Support with Launch

You can launch a website with Everbuilt Studio and get 90 days of free care after it's launched. The Launch package is $2,950 and includes up to 5 pages with custom design.

How the Launch Package Works

You pay a 50% deposit now and the rest at launch. We design up to 5 pages, add contact forms, and include basic SEO. Your site is built on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, so hosting is $0/month.

What You Get

  • Up to 5 pages with custom design
  • Contact forms and SEO basics
  • Hosting on Cloudflare Pages & GitHub (free)
  • 90 days of free care after launch
  • Optional care plans: $295/month or $595/month, cancel anytime

FAQ

What happens after the 90 days of free care? You can choose a care plan at $295/month or $595/month.

Do I own the site? Yes. You own the code, content, and domain outright.

What other options are available? You can also consider the Signature package from $7,500 or the Platform package from $15K for more features.

Next, review the custom website launch package to get started with your launch and 90 days of free care.
